meta.detail: This is a real tldraw canvas: draw, drag and type as usual. Your edits and your agents' edits land on the same document, and every open tab sees them live.

Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, pi, Cursor, opencode and Claude Desktop can all work here once connected. Run `toucan agents install` in a terminal. Their edits glow, and one Cmd-Z undoes a whole run.
When you ask an agent for an opinion, it can answer with dashed proposals you accept or reject. Every canvas keeps its history, so nothing is lost: see the History panel.

In your project, ask your agent: "Use toucan to draw how this repo fits together, and open it for me." The agent runs `toucan init`, which gives the project its own canvas without adding anything to the repo.
On tldraw, every sticky note is a message to your agent, and where you put it is part of the message. Pin one on a box, then ask your agent to handle the notes.
Click Comment and drag around some shapes to start a thread about them. With the Codex CLI signed in, each thread and the chat panel can run their own agent.
